commit_message:
feat(donations): complete multi-currency donation flow, atomic triggers, and receipt views

- DB: Enhanced donations table with multi-currency fields, atomic progress update trigger (tr_update_campaign_current_amount), and RLS policies for guest/authenticated donors
- Backend: Implemented currency conversion service with full exchange rate matrix (lib/services/currency.ts) and typed donation database services (lib/services/donation.ts)
- API: Added createDonationAction server action with Zod validation, campaign status verification, and path revalidations
- UI: Built DonationModal, DonationForm with live currency calculation badge, DonationConfirmation receipt, and RecentSupportersList on campaign detail page
- Tests: 63 Vitest unit/integration tests and 3 Playwright E2E browser tests passing

Closes roadmap step 3.5 and completes Phase 3
